items.title: 'VelociPastor 2' Leaves FilmQuest Audience Roaring, Celebrating Human-Made Films in an AI Era
items.excerpt: At Utah genre festival FilmQuest, AI's spread in the industry met near-universal distrust; one of the biggest applause lines before every screening was a promise that the feature contained no AI.
items.strength: medium (festival AI policy angle; AI is framing, review-heavy)

items.title: 'The Loud House' Moves S10 Production To Canada, Director Says
items.excerpt: Jessica Borutski and Maxwell Atoms discuss lost jobs and AI; neither has seen AI implemented in their studios' workflows, naming Animaj's 'Ozzy Fox' collaboration as the lone exception they know of.
items.strength: weak-medium (AI is one discussion thread; runaway production is the lead)

items.title: Aardman at 50: Keeping Animation Independent and Hand-Made
items.excerpt: Facing consolidation and the rise of AI, employee-owned Aardman bets on handmade stop-motion; the studio draws a sharp line against generative AI but is open to digital tools that improve production efficiency.
items.strength: medium (studio genAI policy; AI is a section, not the lead)

items.title: Jennifer Siebel Newsom Thinks It's Time Tech Leaders Faced Accountability
items.excerpt: Her new documentary 'Miss Representation: Rise Up' argues social platforms and AI tools have been weaponized to harass and silence women and girls.
items.strength: weak (AI is documentary subject, no craft hook)

items.title: Hiding In Plain Sight: Top Execs On Unlocking The Value In Legacy IP

items.strength: medium (AI training-data licensing of film libraries is one section)

items.title: Ex-Disney & NBCU Execs Among New Advisory Board At Pzaz
